ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
Discover ING Hubs RomaniaING Hubs Romania is one of INGs global capability hubs focused on tech, data and risk. Based in Bucharest, we design and deliver digital products to make banking easier for customers everywhere.We offer 180 services in tech, data and analytics, non-financial risk and compliance to ING units worldwide with the help of over 2,300 hi h-performin engineers and data experts to risk specialists, product and operations professionals, working across key domains:Tech Foundation and ChannelsCore Banking and ArchitectureData and AnalyticsGlobal Products and Technology ServicesPayment and Settlement ServicesRisk ServicesProduct and OperationsThe MissionPayments & Settlement Services - Real-Time Payments Engine (RTPE)RTPE is a mission-critical, real-time payments platform processing high-volume, low-latency transactions across ING. It plays a central role in SEPA, instant payments, and ISO 20022 message processing, ensuring availability, resilience, and correctness under strict regulatory and operational constraints.RTPE operates in a 24/7 production environment, handling millions of messages, integrating with multiple upstream and downstream systems, and supporting continuous modernization (e.g. migration from legacy integrations to Java-based listeners and modern event-driven architectures).Your day to dayEven if youll start your day from the comfort of your home or drink your morning coffee in our offices garden, your day will be quite similar when comes to tasks. Here are your daily responsibilities:Being an Engineer, work on user stories that have been broke down from features.Design, develop, and maintain Java-based real-time processing componentsImplement and maintain message driven integrations (MQ, Kafka, APIs)Work with ISO 20022 payment messages (e.g. pacs.008, pacs.002, camt messages)Ensure end-to-end ownership of user stories: analysis, development, testing, release, and production supportParticipate in incident analysis, root cause investigations, and production improvementsCollaborate closely with SRE, product owners, and other global engineering teamsContribute to non-functional requirements: performance, resilience, scalability, securityEnsure compliance with ING IT Risk, audit, and security requirementsParticipate in Scrum ceremonies (stand-ups, refinements, reviews, retrospectives)Demo delivered functionality to stakeholders when requiredWhat youll bring to the teamExperience:5+ years of experience of java development (Java 17 and Java 21)Understanding/work exposure to KafkaExperience/Knowledge of various Java Frameworks - Spring, Spring BootExperience working on CI/CD tools - any would do, we are going to use AzDO.Some experience with XML, XSL, XSDExperience working with TDD and BDDAnalysis SkillsGood communication skills with an appetite to receive feedback whether it is positive or used for improvements.Experience in SCRUM with a strong preference for the agile way of working.Nice to have:Experience/Knowledge of various Java Frameworks.Knowledge of ISO 20022 standards.Some project experience in financial market group treasury.Exposure to observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, logging/alerting)Foreign languages: English (advanced)Education: nice to have bachelors degree (or higher) in an IT related fieldWe enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
